grades.lower_bound_mechanism: finiteness of minimal elements via self-dual intersecting antichain (clutter) theorem: Zorn for minimal transversals + pigeonhole peeling/infinite-descent
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: L = lcm of the finitely many squarefree minimal elements; membership in S_inf invariant under m -> m+L for all m, T = count in [a_1, a_1+L), giving a_{n+T}=a_n+L for all n>=1
grades.notes: Complete alternative route: Step 1 gives the exact characterization; Steps 3-4 replace large-prime erasure with a proved combinatorial theorem (intersecting, antichain, self-dual family of finite sets is finite); pure powers pi(t)^k supply the intersecting property. Periodicity is global from n=1. Header 'under verification' but text is self-contained and the arguments check out.
